metadata.title: Are schools becoming more unequal? Insights from exploratory data mining of international large-scale assessment, TIMSS 2003-2019

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study averaged plausible values to compute school-level statistics, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of multiple plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it used total student weights when computing averages, indicating that sampling weights were applied.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not provide evidence of using multilevel modeling or accounting for school clustering in its analysis of student-level data.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any external validation strategies and appears to rely solely on internal validation methods.
